translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Ale ikel mai galit ke, “Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke gamit galevis mǝttoil gegai, asike lumat van vǝbar lǝb̃eris nagǝmaian hǝn natohan pipihabǝlan aGot, nǝdaŋan han.”
Namǝnas kitin siYesu
Nǝmariboŋ tomǝlevtes tonoŋ aYesu esǝhar aPita, aJemes mai aJon sǝb̃olito vi mǝhat len naṽehuh sua tosahsah. Ale len nǝholito egǝm tile.
Nǝhon em̃ial hum namityal, nahurabat san egǝm pǝhw yesyes vabilbil. Epǝhapǝhw sǝhor avan ideh len navile a pan tolǝboi b̃igole.
Ale aElijah mai aMoses arovisi hǝn galito. Aruhol mai aYesu.
APita ikel mai aYesu ke, “Hai p̃usan, ivoi hǝn dattotoh gegai. Namteum hǝn nǝpasvalǝval titor, tesua esam̃, tesua siMoses, mai tesua siElijah.”
(APita ekǝmaienan husur salǝboi nǝsa b̃ikele, husur lomǝtahw habat.)
Ale nǝmavukasw ikabut gol galito, nadoldol sua egǝm len nǝmavukasw toke, “Ategai bogai, aNatugw ulum̃an notolǝmas buni. Sǝsǝloŋ husuri!”
Losǝhoṽut, lokǝta garu, lǝsaris aMoses mai aElijah am. Be loris aYesu ŋai totoh mai galit ei.
Nǝboŋ lotoput mariŋ dan naṽehuh, ikai tas galit ke saliwal hǝn nǝsa lotorisi mai avan ideh vir aNatun Nǝvanuan b̃ile mǝhat dan nǝmatan.
Imaienan lotǝgau gat nǝsa aYesu tokele len galit gabag, be luhol daŋir husur namilen nasoruan san nǝboŋ toke “b̃ile mǝhat dan nǝmatan.”
Beti lous aYesu ke, “Ahai p̃usan gail hǝn nalo luke aElijah timasgǝm a m̃o. Lokǝmaienan hǝn nǝsa?”

AYesu isor var galit ke, “aElijah egǝm a m̃o hǝn b̃igol natit p̃isi b̃inor tǝtas. B̃imaienan, husur nǝsa natosian siGot ike aNatun Nǝvanuan timaslǝŋon tisa vǝsa len natit tisob̃ur ale nǝvanuan gail limasmǝtahuni?
Be nukel mai gamit ke, aElijah egǝm tia, ale lugol nǝsa sum̃an lotolǝŋoni hǝni, hum ŋai natosian siGot tokel husuri.”
AYesu igol natǝtai tokad natǝmat imaur
Nǝboŋ lototǝlmam van hǝn ahai susur san gail, loris nab̃iltiluṽoh lotodar vis galito mai ahai p̃usan gail hǝn nalo lotoṽitṽituh mai galito.
Nǝboŋ naluṽoh lotoris aYesu, lup̃aŋ, ale lugam van hǝni hǝn lǝb̃ike, “Ivoi,” maii.
AYesu eus ahai susur san gail ke, “Mǝtoṽitṽituh mai galit husur nǝsa?”
Nǝhaṽut sua len naluṽoh isor vari ke, “Hai p̃usan, nosǝhar anatugw ulum̃an gǝm hǝn gaiug. Ikad nanunun tosa sua togol anatugw tovi nab̃ut.
Nǝboŋ natǝmat enan totah gati, ekub̃ hǝn anatugw len tan. Ale nabusun iyau, idesdes batriṽoriṽ, nahumatmat ibari. Nous ahai susur sam̃ gail hǝn lǝb̃ehut natǝmat be lodǝdasi.”
AYesu ikel mai galit ei ke, “Gamit ta damǝŋai mǝtsǝkad nadǝlomian ideh! Nitoh mai gamit tebǝlav mabe? Mitikad nadǝlomian ŋais? Sǝhar natǝtai gǝmai.”
Ale losǝhari van hǝn aYesu. Be nǝboŋ nanunun tosa enan toris aYesu, igol nahumatmat ibar natǝtai, ekub̃ hǝn natǝtai len tan gol italtaloŋ, nabusun iyau.
AYesu eus atǝman natǝtai ke, “Imaiegai ŋais tia?” Isor vari ke, “Etub̃at len nǝboŋ tovi tuhtǝtai ŋai.
Vǝha-sob̃sob̃ur tia natǝmat ekub̃ hǝni len nǝhab o len nǝwai hǝn b̃igol b̃imat. Gǝb̃elǝboi gǝb̃igol natideh, gevi tarhǝt sinamǝru, nǝlom̃ titaŋis ginamǝru.”
AYesu isor vari ke, “Imabe gotoke ‘Gǝb̃elǝboi gǝb̃igole?’ AGot elǝboi b̃igol natit p̃isi. Gǝb̃ikad nadǝlomian, aGot elǝboi b̃igol natideh m̃os gaiug.”
Vǝha-sua ŋai atǝman atuhtǝtai ikai ke, “Nukad nadǝlomian, be gevi tarhǝt sagw len nadǝlomian sagw tob̃uer!”
Nǝboŋ aYesu toris naluṽoh lotogam gǝm hǝni, esivoh len nanunun tosa, ikel maii ke, “Natǝmat gotob̃ut, gotodariŋ b̃ulol, nukele hǝn gaiug ke, gimakuv dani! Sageb̃is lan boŋ ideh am!”
Ale natǝmat eis habat, ekub̃ hǝn natǝtai hum nahumatmat tobari, ale imakuv dani. Natǝtai ehum nab̃irimat gol nǝvanuan isob̃ur ei luke, “Gai imat!”
Be aYesu etǝgau navǝlan natǝtai, elivi vi mǝhat, ale natǝtai eil sǝb̃on.
Nǝboŋ aYesu tonoŋ ei, evi lohoim ale ahai susur san gail sǝb̃olito logǝm hǝni. Lousi ke, “Imabe namtsalǝboi namtb̃ehut natǝmat enan?”
AYesu isor var galit ke, “Natǝmat tomaienan, sǝkad natideh tolǝboi b̃ehuti, be na-sor-tuṽ-an ŋai.”
AYesu isor husur nǝmatan san tǝtas
Beti loriŋ naut enan, luyar tur len naut a Kalili. AYesu emǝtahun avan ideh b̃elǝboi naut lototoh lan,
husur eṽusan ahai susur san gail. Ikel mai galit ke, “Avan sua dereh teriŋ aNatun Nǝvanuan len navǝlan nǝvanuan gail.
Ale dereh ligol timat. Nǝboŋ b̃imat, dereh tile mǝhat len nǝmariboŋ b̃itor husur nǝmatan san.”
Be galit lǝsalǝboi sǝhot namilen nǝsa tokele, ale lomǝtahw, lomǝtahun lǝb̃eusi hǝni.
Ase iyalyal sǝhor galit am?
Nǝboŋ aYesu mai ahai susur san gail lotobar naut a Kapernaum, lob̃is lohoim sua. Ale aYesu eus galit ke, “Mǝtoṽitṽituh husur nǝsa len nǝyaran metp̃isal?”
Be naut eb̃ut, bathut metp̃isal loṽitṽituh gabag len galit ke ase len galito iyalyal sǝhor galit p̃isi.
Ale aYesu ebǝtah, ekis ahai susur lotovi 12 gǝm hǝni ale ikel mai galit ke, “Avan ideh b̃ike b̃eil a m̃o len nabunusian siGot, temǝdau, timassum̃an naslev, teum salit p̃isi.”
Beti esǝhar natuhtǝtai, igol eil rivuh len galito. Ale elugum̃ gati, ikel mai galit ke,

“Avan ideh tohǝhaṽur hǝn natuhtǝtai sum̃an egai b̃itah maii len nahǝsagw, gai ehǝhaṽur hǝn ginau nǝb̃itah maii. Ale avan ideh tohǝhaṽur hǝn ginau nǝb̃itah maii, be savi ginau ŋai, ehǝhaṽur hǝn atenan tosǝvat ginau.”
Avan ideh samǝtahun gidato evi tarhǝt sidato
Ale aJon ikel mai aYesu ke, “Hai p̃usan, namtoris avan sua tohut natǝmat gail len nahǝsam̃, ale namtukai tasi husur savi ginamit ideh.”
Ris aYesu toke, “Samtikai tasi! Sǝkad avan ideh tomadhagol namerikel tolǝboi b̃ikel natideh tosa husur ginau.
Avan ideh samǝtahun gidato evi tarhǝt sidato.
Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke, avan ideh b̃ilav nab̃iliwai hǝn nǝwai mai gamit len nahǝsagw husur mǝtovi seKristo, nokitin, aGot dereh tilav nakonp̃urp̃uran mai avan enan.
Nasǝharian hǝn nǝvanuan van hǝn nǝsaan
“Ale atuhtǝtai tokad nadǝlomian len ginau sum̃an egai, avan ideh b̃igol b̃iteh len nǝsaan, aGot dereh tipansem avan enan sǝhor lǝb̃itahǝtah hǝn nab̃iltivat len naholoan, ale lǝb̃ibar hǝni len tas.
Ale navǝlam̃ b̃igol gǝb̃iteh len nǝsaan, gita kotovi. Ivoi am hǝn gǝb̃evi velm̃etw ale b̃is len nǝmauran vi sutuai, sǝhor gǝb̃ikad navǝlam̃ b̃eru ale vi lan nǝhab nǝmatan, nǝhab topaŋ vi sutuai.
Ale nariem̃ b̃igol gǝb̃ipes hab̃etw, teh len nǝsaan, gita kotovi. Ivoi am hǝn gǝb̃evi rim̃etw ale b̃is len nǝmauran vi sutuai, sǝhor gǝb̃ikad nariem̃ b̃eru ale vi lan nǝhab nǝmatan.

Ale namǝtam̃ b̃igol gǝb̃iteh len nǝsaan, gekis kuvi. Ivoi am hǝn namǝtam̃ b̃esua b̃ib̃esw ale gǝb̃eb̃is len nǝmauran vi sutuai, sǝhor gǝb̃ikad namǝtam̃ b̃eru ale aGot b̃ibar hǝn gaiug len nǝhab nǝmatan.
Len naut enan naul lotoṽis nǝvanuan, lǝsǝmat boŋ ideh, ale nǝhab tohan nǝvanuan sǝmat boŋ ideh.
“Husur aGot dereh tiṽaditdit nǝhab len nǝvanuan p̃isi hum datb̃idardar hǝn nǝtas len nǝhanian.
“Nǝtas ivoi, be nabus han b̃imasig, b̃edub̃e, gigol nabus han tevi tas tǝtas mabe?
Len gamit mitimashum nǝtas, hǝn nabus hamit b̃ivoi, hǝn mǝtb̃ikad natǝm̃at mai gamit gabag.”

footnotes.text: 9.13 Ahap tovi kiŋ mai asoan, nahǝsan aJesepel, arugol risi hǝn arb̃igol aElijah b̃imat (1Ki 19.2, 10). AHerot Antipas tovi kiŋ mai asoan, nahǝsan aHerotias, arugol aJon Baptais tomat. Len naut egai nǝboŋ aYesu tosor husur aElijah, isor husur aJon Baptais.
9.29 Natosian galevis ta sutuai luke na-sor-tuṽ-an mai nǝhanan eb̃uer ŋai.
9.31 Len nasoruan ta Kris naut egai namilen hum ma tovi: Dereh aGot teriŋ aNatun Nǝvanuan len navǝlan nǝvanuan gail.
9.42 Nab̃iltivat enan emǝlas habat, natoŋki esulsul hǝni hǝn b̃ebul dasdas nawit hǝn b̃egǝm vi flaua.

9.49 Len naut egai namilen hum ma tomaiegai: aGot igol nǝvanuan p̃isi lukad nǝboŋ galevis lotodaŋ len nǝmauran salito, nǝboŋ gail lotogol nǝvanuan gail lopǝŋas hum nǝhab togole. Nǝboŋ aGot togol tomaienan, isab̃ alat lotovi esan kitin, ale nǝboŋ galen lotodaŋ lugol nǝvanuan san gail ludaŋ am lan. Be isab̃i am alat lǝsavi esan.

9.50 Len naut a Israel, lutoh a tut dan nabitas gol nǝtas salit savi wai, evi vat. Lotuh dǝdasi hǝn b̃ekǝkereh ale bar hǝni len nǝhanian hǝn b̃igol nabus han b̃ivoi. Nǝboŋ nǝhanian b̃imanuŋ, luhani, be nǝvat a pan savi tas am ale lubar hǝni len nap̃isal.
